Flight Phase

ตัวย้อนแรงขับ

A device that redirects the engine's thrust forward to help slow the aircraft after landing, typically activated on touchdown.

Definition

A device that redirects the engine's thrust forward to help slow the aircraft after landing, typically activated on touchdown.

Operational example

After touchdown, deploy thrust reversers and maximum braking to ensure stopping within the available runway length.
